// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-RELATION
// The same relation, filtered to one class by name. R10 bans a per-class figure
// because a class of one names that child, and the school-scope permission is
// deliberately narrow enough that this is still refused.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function pupilsInNamedClass(className) {
  return db.student.count({ where: { class: { name: className } } });
}
